prompt: Build a login form as a complete static HTML page and write it to `index.html` using your code/write tool. It must include: a heading that says "Sign in", an email text input, a password input, and a Submit button. Use semantic HTML (<h1>, <input>, <button>). Write the whole file; do not describe it.

Build a to-do list page as a complete static HTML page and write it to `index.html` using your code/write tool. It must include: a heading "My Tasks", a text input to type a new task, an "Add" button, and an unordered list (<ul>) with at least three list items (<li>) as example tasks. Use semantic HTML. Write the whole file; do not describe it.

Build a product landing page as a complete static HTML page and write it to `index.html` using your code/write tool. It must include: a top navigation bar (<nav>), a large headline (<h1>), a paragraph of descriptive text, and a call-to-action button that says "Get Started". Use semantic HTML. Write the whole file; do not describe it.

uiChecks.description: has a Get Started CTA button

prompt: Build a pricing section as a complete static HTML page and write it to `index.html` using your code/write tool. It must include a heading "Pricing" and three pricing cards; each card must contain a plan name, a price, and a "Choose" button (three Choose buttons in total). Use semantic HTML. Write the whole file; do not describe it.

Build a contact form page as a complete static HTML page and write it to `index.html` using your code/write tool. It must include: a heading "Contact Us", a name text input, an email input, a message <textarea>, and a "Send" button. Use semantic HTML. Write the whole file; do not describe it.

Build a page header as a complete static HTML page and write it to `index.html` using your code/write tool. It must include a <header> element containing a logo heading "Acme" and a navigation menu (<nav>) with at least three links (<a>). Use semantic HTML. Write the whole file; do not describe it.
